facts: SessionObservationReader now exposes an internal known-live captureLive helper that checks cancellation and returns the same fixed-cut disposable live lease used by the public observation path, without resolving the id through persistence.

SessionCorpus.load clones a captured observation into LogicalSession and disposes the lease on every path. projectMany gives its synchronous projector only a scoped borrowed source, disposes it after projection, and retains unique ordering, bounded persisted workers, late-live preference, typed errors, and the no-persistence fallback.

Complete-history behavior is unchanged at the public owner: readSession still replay-validates the detached raw event log, while event records, surfaces, traces, windows, filters, and titles still consume raw event order and exact inheritedEventCount.

SQLite reconciliation now observes each live session through ctx.sessionQuery with projectionMode none and the reconciliation signal, rejects prepared results as an unstable live-owner race, retries disappearance, clones the detached documents/fingerprint before lease disposal, and keeps the persistence snapshot/generation protocol.
The direct history-reader probe leaves one production call in session-query/src/observation.ts, the live observation owner; Corpus and SQLite have no direct snapshotEvents or eventAt call sites.

Focused tests cover direct known-live capture, fixed cuts after a post-capture append, Corpus routing and lease scope, SQLite observation routing, shadowed-persistence avoidance, and live-owner disappearance retry.
